prompt:
I regret not studying harder for the exam.
I wish I ___ harder for the exam.
explanation: Geçmişteki pişmanlık « wish + past perfect » ile söylenir: I wish I had studied harder.

prompt:
The meeting was cancelled because of bad weather.
The meeting was cancelled ___ weather conditions.
explanation: « because of » yerine daha resmî « owing to / due to » kullanılır; ikisi de isim öbeği alır.

prompt:
I only realised the problem was serious later.
It was not ___ later that I realised how serious the problem was.
explanation: « It was not until + zaman … that » kalıbı « ancak … -dikten sonra » anlamını verir (vurgulu yapı).

prompt:
Someone is repairing my car.
I am ___ repaired.
explanation: Başkasına yaptırılan iş « have + nesne + past participle » ile söylenir: I am having my car repaired.

prompt:
I would prefer it if you didn't smoke here.
I would prefer ___ smoke here.
explanation: « prefer + kişi + (not) to + fiil »: I would prefer you not to smoke here.

prompt:
It's possible that she missed the train.
She ___ missed the train.
explanation: Geçmişle ilgili olasılık « may/might/could + have + past participle » ile ifade edilir.

prompt:
They say that the minister has resigned.
The minister ___ resigned.
explanation: « It is said that … » yerine kişisel edilgen yapı: The minister is said to have resigned (tamamlanmış eylem için perfect infinitive).

prompt:
As soon as he arrived, the phone rang.
No ___ had he arrived than the phone rang.
explanation: « No sooner … than » olumsuz zarf başta olduğunda özne-yardımcı fiil yer değiştirir (inversion): No sooner had he arrived than …

prompt:
Her success was due to hard work.
She succeeded ___ hard work.
explanation: « thanks to + isim » olumlu bir nedeni belirtir: She succeeded thanks to hard work.

prompt:
Very few people attended the lecture.
The lecture was ___ attended.
explanation: « poorly attended » katılımın düşük olduğunu söyleyen yaygın bir eşdizimdir.

prompt:
I'll lend you the money if you promise to pay it back.
I'll lend you the money ___ you pay it back.
explanation: « as long as » koşulu vurgular (« şu şartla ki »); bu anlamda « if » yerine geçer.

prompt:
'You should apply for the job,' my sister told me.
My sister ___ for the job.
explanation: Öneri bildirilirken « advise + kişi + to + fiil » kullanılır: advised me to apply.

prompt:
The last time I saw her was in 2019.
I ___ her since 2019.
explanation: « The last time … was » ile « haven't + past participle + since » aynı şeyi söyler (present perfect).

prompt:
He never thought he would win.
Never ___ he would win.
explanation: « Never » cümle başındaysa yardımcı fiil öne geçer (inversion): Never did he think …

prompt:
The company will succeed only if it innovates.
Only by ___ will the company succeed.
explanation: « Only by + -ing » başa geldiğinde ana cümlede inversion olur: will the company succeed.

prompt:
I was annoyed by his arrogance, not his rudeness.
It was his arrogance ___ annoyed me.
explanation: Vurgulu yapı (cleft sentence): « It was + vurgulanan öğe + that … ».

prompt:
They forced him to sign the contract.
He ___ to sign the contract.
explanation: « make + kişi + fiil » edilgende « be made to + fiil » olur: He was made to sign.

prompt:
If you hadn't helped me, I would have failed.
But ___ your help, I would have failed.
explanation: « But for + isim » = « -mese / olmasaydı »: But for your help, I would have failed.

prompt:
It is pointless to complain to him.
There is ___ complaining to him.
explanation: « There is no point in + -ing » = « -mekte anlam yok ».

prompt:
May I introduce myself first?
Allow ___ introduce myself first.
explanation: « allow + kişi + to + fiil » nazik rica biçimidir.

prompt:
She will certainly win the race.
She is ___ to win the race.
explanation: « be bound to + fiil » = « kesinlikle … -ecek » (güçlü beklenti).

prompt:
I don't mind working late.
I have no ___ working late.
explanation: « have no objection to + -ing » = « -mekte sakınca görmemek »; to burada edat olduğu için -ing gelir.

prompt:
People think the fire was started deliberately.
The fire is ___ started deliberately.
explanation: Geçmişteki bir olay için kişisel edilgen: « is thought to have been + past participle ».

prompt:
He spoke so quietly that I couldn't hear him.
He spoke ___ quietly for me to hear.
explanation: « too + sıfat/zarf + (for kişi) + to + fiil » = « -meyecek kadar ».

prompt:
Although she was tired, she kept running.
Tired ___ she was, she kept running.
explanation: « Sıfat + as + özne + be » = « … olmasına rağmen » (resmî tavizli yapı).

prompt:
It's a pity you didn't tell me earlier.
I wish you ___ me earlier.
explanation: Geçmişe dair istek « wish + past perfect » ile kurulur.

prompt:
We were just about to leave when she called.
We were on the ___ of leaving when she called.
explanation: « be on the point of + -ing » = « tam -mek üzereydi ».

prompt:
If you practise more, you will improve more.
The more you practise, ___ you get.
explanation: « The + comparative …, the + comparative … » paralel artışı anlatır.

prompt:
We had barely sat down when the lights went out.
Hardly ___ sat down when the lights went out.
explanation: « Hardly … when » olumsuz zarf başta olduğu için yardımcı fiil özneden önce gelir: Hardly had we sat down …

prompt:
She never admitted her mistake.
At no time ___ her mistake.
explanation: « At no time » ile başlayan cümlede inversion zorunludur: At no time did she admit …
